rows: One row per graded game, Leo's read of record only (the last read saved before kickoff).
contains: Leo's own output: win chances, margin and total, calls with result and units, miss reasons, plus final scores. No sportsbook line, price or market number in any column.

columns.name: sport
columns.meaning: Always NFL.

columns.name: season
columns.meaning: The season the game belongs to (the year it started).

columns.name: week
columns.meaning: Regular season week number.

columns.name: game_date
columns.meaning: The day the game was played, Eastern time.

columns.name: game_id
columns.meaning: Game identifier (nflverse format: season_week_away_home), stable across files.

columns.name: away_team
columns.meaning: Full name of the away team.

columns.name: home_team
columns.meaning: Full name of the home team.

columns.name: start_utc
columns.meaning: Scheduled kickoff.

columns.name: read_saved_utc
columns.meaning: When Leo's read of record was saved: the last read before kickoff. Nothing in the row was written after it.

columns.name: leo_win_prob_away
columns.meaning: Leo's chance that the away team wins, at the read of record.

columns.name: leo_win_prob_home
columns.meaning: Leo's chance that the home team wins, at the read of record.

columns.name: leo_margin_home
columns.meaning: Leo's expected margin: positive means the home team by that many, negative means the away team. It comes from Leo's margin model, separate from the win chance model, so the two can point to different winners in a close game.

columns.name: leo_total
columns.meaning: Leo's projected total points for both teams.

columns.name: final_away
columns.meaning: Final score of the away team.

columns.name: final_home
columns.meaning: Final score of the home team.

columns.name: overtime
columns.meaning: True when the game went to overtime.

columns.name: ml_side
columns.meaning: Moneyline call: the team Leo took to win. Empty when Leo made no moneyline call or before the three calls began on 2026-11-02.

columns.name: ml_result
columns.meaning: Result of the moneyline call. Empty when there was no call.

columns.name: ml_units
columns.meaning: Units won or lost on the moneyline call, one unit risked, graded at the price when Leo made the call (the price is not in the file).

columns.name: spread_side
columns.meaning: Spread call: the team Leo took against the spread. Empty when no call.

columns.name: spread_result
columns.meaning: Result of the spread call. Empty when there was no call.

columns.name: spread_units
columns.meaning: Units won or lost on the spread call, graded at standard -110.

columns.name: total_side
columns.meaning: Total call: Over or Under. Empty when no call.

columns.name: total_result
columns.meaning: Result of the total call. Empty when there was no call.

columns.name: total_units
columns.meaning: Units won or lost on the total call, graded at standard -110.

columns.name: leo_right_winner
columns.meaning: True when the team Leo gave the higher win chance won. Empty for an exact 50% read or a tie.

columns.name: miss_reason
columns.meaning: When Leo missed (a lost call, the wrong winner, or the margin off by 14 or more), the reason as shown on ndhorizon.com/nfl/results/: Injury input, The market knew, Overtime, Blowout, Variance or Leo's error. Empty when there was no miss.

columns.name: model_version
columns.meaning: Version of Leo's win chance model that made the read.
